spans.text: Nyumu kɛ e yo a si himi ji adebɔ nɔ́ kɛ weku nɛ ba peeɔ wɛtso e sisi jemi.

folded.id: nyumu|loo|yo nɛ e ji
folded.subject: nyumu
folded.object: yo nɛ e ji

spans.text: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ngɛ he blɔhi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ a je ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi a he blɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa kɔ we he nɛ nɔ ko je he, bɔ nɛ nɔ ko e he womi ngɛ, nyumu loo yo nɛ e ji, gbi nɛ e tuɔ, jami mi nɛ e ngɛ, ma mi sane yemi loo juɛmi kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ, ma nɔ loo asafo mi nɛ e je, weto ni nɛ e ngɛ, nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ e fɔmi loo e blɔ nya kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ.

folded.id: nyumuhi|kɛ|yihi nɛ su nihe kɛ zangma mi ɔ́
folded.subject: Nyumuhi
folded.object: yihi nɛ su nihe kɛ zangma mi ɔ́

spans.text: Nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ su nihe kɛ zangma mi ɔ́, a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a ngɔɔ a bi konɛ a wo weku, nɛ wɛtso loo ma nɔ nɛ a ti nɔ ko je loo jami mi nɛ e ngɛ, tsí mɛ blɔ kulaa.

folded.id: pee nyɔguɛ|loo|a maa tsi e nya yaka gu
folded.subject: pee nyɔguɛ
folded.object: a maa tsi e nya yaka gu

spans.text: A be nɔ ko nɔ ko woe ngɔ pee nyɔguɛ loo a maa tsi e nya yaka gu.

folded.id: sa kaa|a|to blɔ nya kɛ ha ma kɛ ma a kake peemi nɔ yami
folded.subject: sa kaa
folded.object: to blɔ nya kɛ ha ma kɛ ma a kake peemi nɔ yami

spans.text: Be abɔ nɛ kake peemi he hia he je ɔ, e sa kaa a to blɔ nya kɛ ha ma kɛ ma a kake peemi nɔ yami.
Blɔ be kaa a kpɔɔ nɔ ko he blɔ nɛ peeɔ lɛ ma ko nɔ no ngɛ e dɛ nɛ sisi numi be he, aloo a ko ngmɛ nɔ ko blɔ ke kaa e suɔ nɛ e ma plɛ e he ma ko nɔ no.

folded.id: sane yemi|kɛ|e mlaa nɛ e yeɔ
folded.subject: sane yemi
folded.object: e mlaa nɛ e yeɔ

spans.text: Jamɛ a ma a ngɛ e he nɔ yee jio, a ngɛ e nɔ yee jio, e ngɛ he wami ko sisi ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ jio, e sane yemi kɛ e mlaa nɛ e yeɔ, aloo e kɛ ma kpahi a kpɛti blɔ nya tomi kɔ we blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko kulaa.

folded.id: sane yemi|loo|juɛmi kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ
folded.subject: sane yemi
folded.object: juɛmi kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ

spans.text: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ngɛ he blɔhi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ a je ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi a he blɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa kɔ we he nɛ nɔ ko je he, bɔ nɛ nɔ ko e he womi ngɛ, nyumu loo yo nɛ e ji, gbi nɛ e tuɔ, jami mi nɛ e ngɛ, ma mi sane yemi loo juɛmi kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ, ma nɔ loo asafo mi nɛ e je, weto ni nɛ e ngɛ, nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ e fɔmi loo e blɔ nya kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ.

folded.id: si himi|kɛ|he blɔhi a blɔ fa mi
folded.subject: si himi
folded.object: he blɔhi a blɔ fa mi

spans.text: Adesahi tsuo ɔ, a bɔ mɛ nɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ e ye e he, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔsɔ ngɛ odehe si himi kɛ he blɔhi a blɔ fa mi.

folded.id: si womi|nɛ|ɔ ma tsu ni ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa ji kaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɛ nu kikɛmɛ a he blɔhi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi
folded.subject: si womi
folded.object: ɔ ma tsu ni ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa ji kaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɛ nu kikɛmɛ a he blɔhi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi

spans.text: Be abɔ nɛ, loko si womi nɛ ɔ ma tsu ni ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa ji kaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɛ nu kikɛmɛ a he blɔhi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi.

folded.id: te si|kɛ|si he blɔhi klɛdɛɛ nɛ mlaa kɛ ma nɔ yemi mlaa haa lɛ ɔ
folded.subject: te si
folded.object: si he blɔhi klɛdɛɛ nɛ mlaa kɛ ma nɔ yemi mlaa haa lɛ ɔ

spans.text: He blɔ ngɛ ha nɔ fɛɛ nɔ, nɛ Amlaalɔ ɔ e kojoli kpakpahi a dlaa nɛ a kojoɔ e sane ɔ haa lɛ, ke munyu ko maa te si kɛ si he blɔhi klɛdɛɛ nɛ mlaa kɛ ma nɔ yemi mlaa haa lɛ ɔ.

folded.id: tɔ mlaa|nɛ|hɛɛ tue gblami
folded.subject: tɔ mlaa
folded.object: hɛɛ tue gblami

spans.text: A be nɔ ko fɔ bue ke e tɔ mlaa nɛ hɛɛ tue gblami, benɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ tsɔɔ we mlaa tɔmi ngɛ ma mlaa, loo mahi a kpɛti mlaa nɛ ngɛ nɔ yee jamɛ a be ɔ mi.

folded.id: tue gbomi|nɛ|maa te si kɛ si nɔ mi hlami nɛ a tsi to ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi
folded.subject: tue gbomi
folded.object: maa te si kɛ si nɔ mi hlami nɛ a tsi to ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi

spans.text: Mlaa ma fa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he sɔsɔɛ, ngɛ tue gbomi nɛ maa te si kɛ si nɔ mi hlami nɛ a tsi to ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi, aloo nɔ́ ko nɛ ma wo nɔ mi hlami kɛ ba a blɔ fa mi.

folded.id: we he|nɛ|nɔ ko je he
folded.subject: we he
folded.object: nɔ ko je he

spans.text: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ngɛ he blɔhi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ a je ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi a he blɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa kɔ we he nɛ nɔ ko je he, bɔ nɛ nɔ ko e he womi ngɛ, nyumu loo yo nɛ e ji, gbi nɛ e tuɔ, jami mi nɛ e ngɛ, ma mi sane yemi loo juɛmi kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ, ma nɔ loo asafo mi nɛ e je, weto ni nɛ e ngɛ, nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ e fɔmi loo e blɔ nya kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ.

folded.id: we mi|loo|e womi mi munyuhi a mi bɔ nɛ sɛ
folded.subject: we mi
folded.object: e womi mi munyuhi a mi bɔ nɛ sɛ

spans.text: He blɔ be nɛ a woɔ nya ngɔ woɔ nɔ ko e kɔkɔɔ mi sane loo e weku munyu, e we mi loo e womi mi munyuhi a mi bɔ nɛ sɛ, aloo a gbee e he guɛ kɛ puɛɔ e blɔ nya nɛ e hɛɛ.

folded.id: weto ni|nɛ|e ngɛ
folded.subject: weto ni
folded.object: e ngɛ

spans.text: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ngɛ he blɔhi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ a je ngɔ tsɔɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi a he blɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa kɔ we he nɛ nɔ ko je he, bɔ nɛ nɔ ko e he womi ngɛ, nyumu loo yo nɛ e ji, gbi nɛ e tuɔ, jami mi nɛ e ngɛ, ma mi sane yemi loo juɛmi kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ, ma nɔ loo asafo mi nɛ e je, weto ni nɛ e ngɛ, nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ e fɔmi loo e blɔ nya kpa ko nɛ e hɛɛ.

folded.id: ye gbeye|kɛ|ohia nɔ kunimi
folded.subject: ye gbeye
folded.object: ohia nɔ kunimi

spans.text: Be abɔ nɛ adesa he blɔhi a nɔ tue gbomi kɛ he guɛ gbemi wo basabasa ni peemihi kɛ ba gba je ɔ tsuo nya he je ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ kaa jehanɛ ɔ, adesa maa ye gbeye kɛ ohia nɔ kunimi, nɛ e ma na hemi kɛ yemi kɛ nya kɛ tu munyu, nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ ji nimli gu ɔmɛ a hiami nihi nɛ pe kulaa.

folded.id: yi fɔ|kɛ|ya si a maa kojo lɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi nɛ a maa bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ mlaa nya benɛ e na e he fami he blɔ tsuo ta
folded.subject: yi fɔ
folded.object: ya si a maa kojo lɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi nɛ a maa bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ mlaa nya benɛ e na e he fami he blɔ tsuo ta

spans.text: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɛ a ma wo sane nɛ hɛɛ tue gblami kɛ si lɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ kaa e yi fɔ kɛ ya si a maa kojo lɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi nɛ a maa bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ mlaa nya benɛ e na e he fami he blɔ tsuo ta.
